# Pervasive Annotation Errors Break Text-to-SQL Benchmarks and Leaderboards

[All reading notes](../reading-notes.md) · [Catalog entry](../README.md#annotation-errors)

**Full paper read · 2026-11-09**

[Original source](https://www.vldb.org/pvldb/vol19/p931-jin.pdf) · PVLDB 19(5), 2026; paper-linked supplementary_material.pdf

**Reading coverage:** All 14 proceedings pages, Sections 1-10, Tables 1-7 and figures/captions; all 4 supplementary pages A.1-A.4 including model substitutions and correction settings.

**Additional inspected sources:** [Scientific supplement](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/uiuc-kang-lab/text_to_sql_benchmarks/main/materials/supplementary_material.pdf)

## Research question

Annotation errors and underspecified questions can distort both SQL correctness labels and rankings used to compare agents.

## Method

SAR-Agent probes databases and drafts diagnoses; two authors independently check flagged cases, with consensus adjudication and additional pattern-driven review. SAPAR combines diagnoses with human correction of questions, knowledge, SQL, schema and sometimes database rows.

## Evaluation

Audits 498 unique BIRD Mini-Dev examples and 121 public-gold Spider2-Snow cases. Re-runs 16 reproducible agents on a random 100-example BIRD subset before and after correction; supplements disclose substituted backend models and four correction settings.

## What the results support

Reports 263/498 and 76/121 examples with annotation issues, including ambiguity. Corrections change agent accuracy and rank; SQL-only correction produces different rankings from fully corrected inputs. Diagnostic precision is measured against human review, not automatic ground truth.

## Limits and qualifications

Spider coverage is a dated public-gold subset, not all 547 tasks or current releases. Agent reruns sometimes substitute models, so they do not exactly reproduce leaderboard configurations. Corrections alter inputs as well as labels; the 100-case reranking is not a corrected full leaderboard, and false-negative recall is not exhaustively established.

## Relevance to reliable Text-to-SQL

Supports auditing evaluation references and recording ambiguity policies before interpreting reliability or abstention scores.
